# Morgan

## Appearance

Morgan Sloane is described as a tall and lean individual. Additionally, a lady associated with the name Morgan is portrayed as a short, stout, gray-haired woman who wears a tweed suit.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P30](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0030)_

## Personality

Morgan is a kindhearted individual and an exceptionally delightful conversationalist. Having traveled extensively, she possesses a talent for excellent storytelling. Her brilliant presence easily earns the admiration and affection of those around her.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)_

## History

Mrs. Charlotte E. Morgan was a well-traveled individual and an excellent storyteller. She was initially expected as a guest of honor at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), but was unable to attend after spraining her ankle.

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P2](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0002), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P4](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0004), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P5](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0005), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P6](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0006), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P7](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0007), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P11](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0011), +73 more_

## Relationships

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

[Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) is Mrs. Morgan's niece. She serves as an intermediary by introducing Mrs. Morgan to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and bringing her to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a visit. Their interaction facilitates a pleasant afternoon of dining and walking with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

- Relative of — niece  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024)</sub>
